chapter.verse: Tua gamlumna a bei khit ciangin Paul in nungzuite sam a, a hansuah khit ciangin, amaute tawh kikhenin Makedonia gamah a pai hi.
Tua gamah paisuakin thu-um mite a hansuah khit ciangin Grik gam a tung hi.
Kha thum a om khit ciangin teembaw tawh Siria gamah pai dinga akisak lai takin Judah mite in ama tungah bawlsiatna ding a hanciam uh ahih ciangin, Makedonia gam lamah paikik ding a hanciam kik uh hi.

Paul tawh Asia gam a zin dingin a paikhawm mite in Bera khua mi Pirras’ tapa Sopater, Thesalonika khua mi Aristarkhus leh Sekundus, Derbe mi Gaia, Listra mi Timoti, Asia gam mi Tikhikas leh Trofimas-te ahi uh hi.
Hih mite a pai masa uh a, Troas khua-ah kote hong ngak uh hi.
Silngo-sawh loh Anlum pawikham ni a bei khit ciangin kote in Filippi khua pan teembaw tuangin ka pai uh a, ni nga ni-in amaute kiang Troas khua-ah ka tung uh hi. Tua khua ah ni sagih ka tam uh hi.
Ni sagih sung pan ni masa bel ni-in khomun balnen dingin ka kikhop lai takun, Paul in zingsang cianga pai sawm ahih manin amaute tawh kihopih a, zankim dongin thu a hilh hi.
Inn dei tungnung kote kikhopna-ah meivak tampi a om hi.
Eutikhas min nei tangval khat in kongvangneu gei-ah a tut lai takin lusu-in, a ihmu hi. Paul in sawtveipi thu hilh ahih ciangin tua tangval ihmu a, inn thuap thum tung pan kiasuk a, a si hi.
Paul in a nuai-ah kumsukin, ama tungah lum a, a kawi khit ciangin, “Gamlum kei un. Ama sungah hin’na a om lai hi!” a ci hi.
Paul paito kik a, khomun balnenin a neek khit uh ciangin, amaute tawh khuavak dongin sawtveipi a kihopih khit uh ciangin paikhia hi.
Mite in tangvalnopa a nungta-in innah a paipih uh a, a lungdam mahmah uh hi.
Kote in Paul mai-ah teembaw tawh pai-in Assos khua pan amah lak ding ka hanciam uh a, tua khua-ah ka pai uh hi. Bang hang hiam i cih leh, Paul in tua khua dongin lei lam zui a, pai ding a hanciam hi.
Assos khua panin ka kituah uh ciangin amah ka la uh a, Mitilena khua-ah ka pai uh hi.
Tua khua panin ka paikik uh ciangin, a zingciangin Khios tuikulh kiangah ka tung uh a, ni khat khit ciangin Samos tuikulh ka tung uh a, ni khat khit kik leuleu ciangin Miletas khua ka tung uh hi.

Bang hang hiam i cih leh, Paul in Pentekost pawikham ni a tun’ ma-in Jerusalem khua a tun’ zawh man khak leh ci-in hahkat a, Asia gamah sawtpi om nuam lo ahih ciangin, Efesa khua-ah khawl loin pai ding a hanciam zo hi.
Miletas khua panin Paul in Efesa khua-ah mi paisakin pawlpi upate a sam hi.
Amaute a tun’ uh ciangin Paul in a gen-inah: “Asia gam ka tun’ ni-a kipan tu dongin nomau tawh bang ci gamtat-in a tawntungin ka omkhawm nong thei uh hi.
Lungsim kiniamsakin, khitui luangin Judah mite’ hanciamna hoih lo bawlsiatna thuakin, Topa’ na ka sem hi.
Note ading thupha khat beek siit loin mi kikhopna sungah ahi zongin, inn khat pan inn khatah ahi zongin, ka hong hilh hi.
Pasian mai-ah kisikkikna thu ahi zongin, eite Topa Zeisu Khazih upna ahi zongin, Judah mi leh Grik mite kiangah ka hilh hi cih note’n na thei uh hi.
Tu-in Kha Siangtho kikhihna thuakin Jerusalem khua-ah ka pai ding hi. Tua khua panin ka tungah bang thu a piang ding hiam ka thei kei hi.
Ahih hangin kihenna leh thong sung khiat nadingte in kei hong ngak hi ci-in Kha Siangtho in khua khempeuh ah kei hong hilh hi.
Ahih hangin Pasian’ hehpihna Lungdamna Thu hilh nading Topa Zeisu’ khut sung pan ka ngah za ahi, ka nasepna ka zawh theih nadingin ka nuntakna keimah ading phamawh ka sa kei hi.
Ka pai kawikawi-a Pasian’ Gam thu kong hilh note khempeuh in keima maitang na mu nawn kei ding uh hi cih tu-in ka thei hi.
Tua ahih ciangin mi khempeuh’ si tungah khial loin ka om hi ci-in nomau kiangah ka hong lak hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Pasian’ thu buppi note kiangah gen dingin ka pelh kei hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa in a si tawh a lei pawlpi vaak dingin Kha Siangtho in note a hong koih, tuunote leh nomau pumpi uh pha takin na kem un.
Ka pai khit ciangin gilo ngiate in nomau lakah lutin, a tuute a hehpih kei ding uh hi.
Nungzuite a zolkhia dingin thuzuau a gen mite in note lakah a piang ding uh hi cih ka thei hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kikem un. Keimah in kum thum tawntung sun tawh zan tawh pelh loin mi khempeuh khitui tawh hilhin, ka om na mangngilh kei un.

Tu-in Pasian kiangah note kong pia hi. Note hong kipsak nading ahi zongin, misiangthote khempeuh tawh a kibangin note in luahna na ngah nading uh ahi zongin, ahih thei Pasian’ hehpihna thupha ah note kong ap hi.
Kuama kham ahi zongin, ngun ahi zongin, puan ahi zongin ka deihgawh kei hi.
Hih ka khut in keimah leh keimah tawh a omkhawmte hong vaak note in na thei uh hi.

Tua bangin note in na nasep uh a, thahat lo mite na huh ding uh a, ‘Ngahna sangin piakna-ah thupha lianzaw hi,’ ci-in Zeisu in a genna kammal na ngaihsut dingun na khempeuh ah note kiangah thugentehna kong lak zo hi,” ci-in a gen hi.
Paul in tua bang a gen khit ciangin khukdin’ a, amaute tawh thu a ngen hi.
Amaute khempeuh in nakpi-in a kap uh a, Paul’ ngawng kawi-in a nam uh hi.
Tu nung ciangin ama maitang a mu nawn kei ding uh hi a cihna kammal hangin a dah pen uh hi. Amaute in Paul teembaw ah a kha uh hi.
